name: Ranger: Skirmish moves the displayed melee crit chance (#10401)
contract: Skirmish (802039) tooltip: 'Increases your critical strike chance by $s2%...'. Effect[1] applies SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE (custom aura type 350, EffectMiscValue[1]=127 i.e. all schools), handled as HandleNoImmediateEffect: it is read live at melee/ranged/spell crit-roll time (Unit.cpp) but Player::UpdateCritPercentage never folded it into PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE, so the paperdoll/combat-log-displayed crit chance never moved even though real rolls were already correct. The fix wires AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModCritChance into the handler table at this aura index so apply/remove recomputes PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE/PLAYER_RANGED_CRIT_PERCENTAGE/PLAYER_OFFHAND_CRIT_PERCENTAGE. Skirmish's own DurationIndex is 0 (GetDuration() == 0): live, it is granted with a script-set duration tied to Advantage stacks, which the set_aura fixture bypasses, so set_aura now gives any zero/negative-max-duration fixture aura a 60s lifetime (CoAGameplayTest.cpp) so it survives long enough to assert against instead of expiring on the next tick. The DBC's EffectBasePoints[1]=14 is the stored minimum roll; AzerothCore's own BasePoints-to-effective-value convention adds 1 (DieSides=1, no further randomness), so AuraEffect::GetAmount() for this effect, confirmed directly (aura_amount), is 15 - the number this regression checks against, not the raw DBC field.

steps.label: Apply Skirmish directly as a fixture aura
SETUP: Skirmish's crit effect amount is 15
Removing Skirmish drops the displayed melee crit chance by its 15-point effect amount
